inventory.mission: Sustain vagal tone so heart-rate-variability-linked recovery signalling remains robust under repeated stress exposure.

inventory.title: Adipose Endocrine Regulation
inventory.mission: Regulate adipose-derived endocrine signalling and local glucocorticoid responsiveness to communicate metabolic state and coordinate hormonal adaptation.

canonical_inputs.role: Defined oral DHA exposures can modulate circulating adiponectin, an adipose-derived endocrine signal.
canonical_inputs.limitation: Admission concerns a circulating hormone response in studied supplement/enriched-oil contexts. It does not establish adipose secretion, receptor sensitivity, universal benefit, ordinary-food efficacy or a food-effective dose. Mixture and carrier effects are not attributed to DHA alone; DHA-specific attribution uses the separate DHA-versus-EPA trial.

inventory.title: Stress-Modulated Appetite & Reward Regulation
inventory.mission: Coordinate stress-responsive hypothalamic and reward signalling to regulate appetite and food-seeking motivation as physiological demands change.
